s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive unilateral skin hardening with limited joint motion
salient_findings: Unilateral skin hardening on the right thigh and buttock
Mild hypertrichosis and hyperpigmentation of the affected skin
Slight thickening of subcutaneous tissue on MRI
key_facts: 11-year-old boy presented with a 7-year history of progressive skin hardening
Skin hardening is unilateral, affecting the right thigh and buttock
Motion of the right limb joint is slightly limited
Normal results for routine blood tests, autoantibodies, immunoglobulins, C-reactive protein, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate
MRI of the right thigh showed slight thickening of subcutaneous tissue and T2 signal abnormality
Histopathological findings include normal epidermis, mild pigmentation, and increased density of fibroblasts
Immunohistochemical staining showed increased expression of CD34 in the reticular dermis
Alcian blue staining was negative

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive unilateral skin hardening with limited joint motion
salient_findings: Unilateral skin hardening on the right thigh and buttock
Mild hypertrichosis and hyperpigmentation of the affected skin
Slight thickening of subcutaneous tissue on MRI
key_facts: 11-year-old boy presented with a 7-year history of progressive skin hardening
Skin hardening is unilateral, affecting the right thigh and buttock
Motion of the right limb joint is slightly limited
Normal results for routine blood tests, autoantibodies, immunoglobulins, C-reactive protein, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate
MRI of the right thigh showed slight thickening of subcutaneous tissue and T2 signal abnormality
Histopathological findings include normal epidermis, mild pigmentation, and increased density of fibroblasts
Immunohistochemical staining showed increased expression of CD34 in the reticular dermis
Alcian blue staining was negative

differentials: diffuse systemic sclerosis with bullous lesions

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of progressive unilateral skin hardening, limited joint motion, and characteristic histopathological findings of increased fibroblast density and CD34 expression are consistent with en coup de sabre scleroderma, a rare form of localized scleroderma.

rejected.label: scleromyxedema
rejected.why: Scleromyxedema typically presents with widespread skin induration, papules, and mucin deposition, which is not consistent with this patient's unilateral skin hardening and negative Alcian blue staining.

rejected.label: poikiloderma
rejected.why: Poikiloderma is characterized by a combination of atrophy, telangiectasia, and pigmentary changes, which are not the primary features of this patient's presentation.

rejected.label: h syndrome
rejected.why: H syndrome is a rare genetic disorder characterized by a distinct set of features including hyperpigmentation, hypertrichosis, and other systemic manifestations, which do not align with this patient's primary complaint of progressive skin hardening.

rejected.label: sclerodactyly
rejected.why: Sclerodactyly refers to the thickening and hardening of the skin of the fingers, which is not consistent with this patient's presentation of skin hardening on the thigh and buttock.
